Name: Reg
Dialog: (in the living room) That, ladies and gents, is how I defeated the wild tigers in the Amazon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome story, Grandpa Reg.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I'm sure you're going to hear plenty more fantastical stories during Gran and Gramp's visit.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, hon, I was thinking we could all head to the mall.

Name: Winifred
Dialog: What a splendid idea! I'd love to treat Candace to some new clothes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I'll be in the... car.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Could we just stay home and hear some more of Grandpa's cool stories?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sounds good to me.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wonderful. (He, Linda, Candace and Winifred leave) We'll see you boys later.

Name: Reg
Dialog: My boy, what's this behind your ear? It's me scrapbook!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How'd you do that?

Name: Re
Dialog: It's just a little bit of "How's you're father". I may seem like a barmy ol' git now, but when I wasn't so long in the tooth, I had some grand larks and engaged in a fair amount of derring-do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Translate.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: When he was younger, he did a bunch of stuff.

Name: Reg
Dialog: Here I am as a young lad. I made my livin' workin' at the family Fish and Chips shop. (Chuckles) But I was destined for bigger things. I was known as The Great Flying Fishmonger. Here's my first jump over my dear mum's tea society; Me jumpin' a whale; *a ton of crumpets; the Queen Mum. But there was one jump that haunts me to this day; McGregor's Gorge of Doom.

Name: Reg
Dialog: (cntd) (Narrating) People turned out by the thousands to witness me in my trusty motor bike, the Holy Mackerel, make our biggest jump yet. The event was so massive, I hired a local band to write me **a theme song**.

Name: Reg
Dialog: But it wasn't exactly a toe-tapper. Then all of a sudden, it started to rain. I had to postpone my great feat. The second go at it weeks later had the same result! And yet another attempt; nothing but blasted rain again.

Name: Man
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Yeah. I've got teeth not to brush.

Name: Reg
Dialog: (Present day) Over the years, my eyesight went, and with the lumbago... (Grunts) ...Sciatica... (Creaking) ...Bursitis and... Wait for it... (Boing!) Trick knee, jumpin' McGregor's Gorge is an intention lost to the past.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Grandpa. So whatever happened to the Holy Mackerel?

Name: Reg
Dialog: She's right over there. Although I see your mother turned her into a lamp.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Grandma, you're gonna love this mall! I'll show you my favorite store, and there's this little dress that-- (Ding) Hmm... (Dialing) Stacy, I have a strange feeling that ground was just broken in my backyard. I need you to get over there and tell me what's going on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Judging from this photo of McGregor's Gorge, we're right on track! Who's the tiger?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. We're helping Grandpa Reg fulfill his crushed dreams.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where's Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's in the garage restoring the mackerel. (Briefly, Ferb is seen working on the mackerel in the garage, he stops to eat a grilled cheese sandwich)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool. Well, I brought this cute little toy over for Perry. Where is he?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. I don't know.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, hey, Agent P. Monogram's thrown his back out...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm on the floor, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...so I'll be giving you your assignment, okay? 'Kay.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Do a closeup.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Huh? Oh, yeah. Huh. (Beep; Clears throat) Doofenshmirtz has been purchasing some suspicious items: Bags of sand; an extra-long shoelace. We know he's up to no good. Get out there and see what he's up to. (To Major Monogram) How was that?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just hand me my pills, Carl.

Name: Reg
Dialog: (Phineas and Ferb lead him out with his eyes covered) What's all the kerfuffle, lads?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can open your eyes now.

Name: Reg
Dialog: (puts arms down, monocle falls off) Blimey! It's McGregor's Gorge and the Holy Mackerel! Ferb, you've restored my pride and joy! But, uh, I can't operate a motorbike in my condition. Remember the- (Boing!)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a problem. Ferb's tricked out the entire bike. Lumbar support, padded seating, ergonomic controls, and the best part - Side cars! See, as much as we wanna help you fulfill your dream, we also really want to jump a gorge.

Name: Reg
Dialog: Well, then you'll come with me. The Flyin' Fishmongers shall jump again!

Name: Winifred
Dialog: Oh, my dear! You look like a queen. Brava!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing British clothes) Uh, can we get out of here, like, now? Before anyone I know happens to see--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? I almost didn't recognize you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! I-- I, uh--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I gotta meet my Mom in the food court, but I'll see ya later?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughs nervously) (Phone rings) Hello? Oh, hey, Stacy. (To Linda) Mom! Stacy just told me the boys built a huge gorge in the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That hat might be a bit too tight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, just come in! Into my trap! Yes! Sticky flypaper, Perry the Platypus! (Laughs) Quick story? Back in Druselstein in the days of my youth, there was a bully named Boris, who always wore big, black boots. They called him "Big Black Boots Boris the Bully". He was always kicking sand in my face. When I was in the sandbox; Sand. My first date; Sand! Balancing my checkbook; Sand! The beach-- Oddly enough nothing. But I couldn't relax, because I kept waiting for it. Now, though, he will be the one doing the waiting. Behold! The Now who's blinded by sand-inator! Or maybe the Who's crying now-inator or, something like...something with the "Inator" suffix. In any case, it's a giant sand kicking machine! You see, Perry the Platypus, Boris has moved to the Tri-State Area, so now, I am going to cover his entire house in sand! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Come see The Flying Fishmongers jump McGregor's Gorge! Tell your friends!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Do you know how dumb you look?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I thought it would be a good way to get more attention.

Name: Cindy
Dialog: I love your outfit. It's so cute.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Gorge!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gorge jump!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fishmongers fly again!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Come see The Flying Fishmonger jump the gorge; Live.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) That's our yard! Mom! Mom! Come here! I need you to see this! (drags Linda to the TV and motions toward it with eyes closed)

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Sponsored by Gorgeous Cream Pore Paste.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, you're pores aren't that big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, what you've all come to see, The Flying Fishmongers! (Crowd cheers) And here to play the Fishmonger's anthem are Isabella and the Fireside Girls. Hit it!

Name: Reg
Dialog: Well, me boy, looks like I'll never get to fulfill my dream.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys. You can stop playing. (Rain stops) Wait a second. Start again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Stop. Start.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grandpa, the song's so dreary, it's causing it to rain. What if we pep it up a bit?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Pep away, me boy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella, crank it up a notch!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okey-Dokey! (At Fireside Girls) Ready, girls?

Name: Newspaper Boy
Dialog: Extra, extra! Fishmonger and kids jump McGregor's Gorge! (Crowd cheering) Extra, extra! Fishmonger and kids plummet to their doom!

Name: Reg
Dialog: Maybe we should have let it rain!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Grandpa! We've got a backup plan! (To Ferb) Ferb? (Ferb pulls lever, Plane wings come out)

Name: Reg
Dialog: Good show! (Wing breaks)

Name: Newspaper Boy
Dialog: Extra, extr-- Aw, forget it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that can't be good.

Name: Reg
Dialog: Spot of tea?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, all right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, can we speed up this pony ride a little?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Honey, I'll have you ladies home in two shakes of a lamb's tail. (Tires screech) Whoo! That was a close one.

Name: Kids
Dialog: (Bounce house deflates) Aw. (Engine revving)

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Good show, me boy! Good show!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) The home of my former nemesis. Time to kick a little sand, eh, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tube socks? What is this, 1974? Well, it's too late now...oh! (Button beeps) What are you doing?

Name: Winifred
Dialog: Home again, home again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, finally!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Thank you, lads. For helping this old codger fulfill his dream.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs into the backyard) Ha! You guys are sooooo busted! (sees the gorge) Look at this, it's even better than I thought! There's no way you're gonna get out of this one! (runs off) Oh, Mom? Mom?!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cut it out, Perry the Platypus! No grabbies! Ha! No stopping it now! (Bucket clangs, Wind gusting) Even on my Sand-Kicking machine; Sand! (Bucket clangs, Boot flies, Soil patches gorge)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cntd) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: I must say, love the new anthem.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: But I do miss the old one. Couldn't I hear it one last time?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got it, Grandpa. One last time, girls!

Name: Candace
Dialog: These two have really done it this time, Mom, (with eyes closed) look at what they did to the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (smiles) Wow!

Name: Linda (cont'd.)
Dialog: (offscreen) You guys made the lawn look great! (Candace opens her eyes and turns her head, realizing the gorge disappeared.) Oh, it's all weeded and watered... Oh, well done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I... I... (Squeaks) I...!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What else did you do today?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Well, these two roister-doisters wheeled out me old iron, built a crackin' match for McGregor's Gorge, and helped this daft ol' git have one last knees-up.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Phineas looks at him in a "translate-for-me" kind of way.) I have absolutely no idea.
